children: Cyprus-based oil and gas company Energy Holdings
has agreed to buy deepwater drilling contractor Ventura Offshore
to create a larger platform for cash generation, shareholder distribution and growth, the Oslo-listed companies said on Friday.

Under the agreement, Ventura shareholders would receive 605 million shares in Energy Holdings. That implies a pro forma equity value of about $1 billion for the combined company, based on Energy Holdings' last closing price and the maximum number of shares to be issued.
The deal would allow Ventura shareholders to gain exposure to a larger and more diversified portfolio of cash-generative businesses, Ventura CEO Guilherme Coelho said.
Both Coelho and Energy Holdings CEO Kurt Waldeland would continue in their current roles.
Ventura Offshore would be delisted from Oslo Euronext Growth.
Energy Holdings expects the new board to consider a potential U.S. dual-listing and IPO for the combined group, Waldeland said.
